shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), transit animations, finished-art blueprints (§74) + wall risers (§75 a-d; d unlaunched; §62.J column-top question PENDING USER ANSWER). Workshop 3776015553. Owed: §62.J answer, relaunch, final riser art, smoke test, notes-paste, §70, upstream paste.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED from the tree (survives in git history pre-a50a744). ~117 .cs files, ~34,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: COMPAT FIELD TEST (run #330, DBH+Rimefeller+VNutrientE+RimIOT+Eccentric companions), MID-SESSION.** Session so far: 4 vanilla runs (§74 clean, §75 a/b/c fixed+verified) → compat run #330: user reported carrier art visible (nutrient both levels, plumbing upper level, power above column). DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE (decompiled PipeSystem/DBH/Rimefeller/Rimatomics): (1) **Dubs-family mods print pipe things' NORMAL art through their OWN SectionLayer_Things subclasses** (DBH `SectionLayer_ThingsSewagePipe`, Rimefeller `SectionLayer_ThingsPipe`/`SectionLayer_SewagePipe`, Rimatomics `SectionLayer_ThingsPipe`) - bypassed the general-layer hide → **§75.d BUILT 0w/0e (unlaunched):** shared `ShouldPrint` verdict + boot installer patching those layers by name (map-comp anchors from DubsPipeCompat.Hosts; rule-33 warning if a host loads with zero patched layers). VEF needs nothing (SectionLayer_Resource = frame-gated overlay-only; normal art via general layer, already covered). (2) Remaining visible stubs = the INTENTIONAL §62.J column-top up-cell art → **⚠ QUESTION PENDING WITH USER: hide column floor-above stubs too (revoke §62.J visibility)? If YES: collapse ShouldPrint to unconditional IsCarrier-hide (3-line change) + rebuild before relaunch. Do NOT flip without the answer.** No [automated] errors run #330 except known-benign Rimefeller dds. Workspace dll DEBUG. ⚠ Rule 29 (w9): utility run + notes paste never separately confirmed.

**GIT:** `Astryls/As-above-So-below`, `main`, `eb3dad9` pushed. Autosave active - harmless. Session's work (§74, §75 a-d, temp art) not manually committed; checkpoint if autosave missed it.

**⚠ OWED, IN ORDER:** (1) **§62.J answer → possible 3-line flip + rebuild → RELAUNCH compat session** (verify §75.d: no plumbing/nutrient art at riser cells in normal view; overlays intact; run `AB2: network scan` for §62.N formal criteria `PipeSystem: bound=N | skip: (none)`). (2) **FINAL riser art** (Gemini PAUSED r5: camera-donor breakthrough, strip-width units next; REWRITE kit prompts to REAL palette - no copper: power=steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+red valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan). (3) **WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST** (3776015553 WORKSHOP copy; none of §74/§75 aboard). (4) w9 notes-paste confirm. (5) Smooth Terrain upstream paste. (6) §70 Caverns verify.

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (Workshop):** §62.N (compat-session evidence positive, formal check open), §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7). USER-VERIFIED: §72, §72.b, §71 baseline, §73; §74+§75a/b/c (vanilla runs this session). TREE ONLY: §74, §75(a-d).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits; §75 temp set = explicit user-ordered TEMPORARY exception; render_svg_to_png otherwise = flat UI geometry only. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE THIRTY-EIGHT RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER; MESH AND OVERLAYS ARE SEPARATE METHODS. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW.
